description: Wait for quotes or a final price after requesting them. Returns as soon as they're ready, or after timeoutSeconds with the status so far; call again while they're still running. When quotes are ready, it returns the quote list too. A final price is ready once it's resolved. If a Jerry agent takes it over (manual) or it's taking longer than usual (delayed), the wait stops with that reason, and the status's nextStep says what happens next. Calling again on a delayed price keeps waiting.

for.description: quotes after jerry_request_quotes; final_price after jerry_request_final_price requested it.

intentId.description: The shopping intent id returned by an earlier shopping tool.

timeoutSeconds.description: Longest time to wait, in seconds; default 20, at most 20.

name: jerry_wait
title: Wait for results
